screens.screen: administration hub 'الادارات' (branch settings, shop categories, shops, drivers, employees, wallets, offers, notifications) with 5-tab bottom nav
wallets management (every user's wallet with account type, wallet number, balance and debit/credit tag)
branch settings form (platform fee %, sign-up gifts, delivery distance/time, daily order cap, cost per km, Tawsela account and commission)

notes: Checked the layout: this is a phone app (BottomNavigationBar, single-column lists, no side rail or data tables), not a desktop/web panel, so it is drawn at 390x844. The repo is an earlier fork of the Employee app's code (version 1.0.0), so the hub and management screens are the same code in both; Admin shows the management side and Employee shows the order-handling side. No font is bundled, so it is drawn with the iOS system Arabic font (SF Arabic). In the hub only 'إدارة العروض' has an icon inside its avatar; the other avatars are plain blue-grey circles in the code. The wallets list prints the account type through .tr(), but this repo's ar.json has no keys for user types, so the raw values (business / driver / customer / employee) appear, as drawn. Names, numbers and balances are sample data.
